promptTemplate: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production transparent sprite sheet for 2D mobile idle RPG. Square 2048x2048 sheet, exact 2 by 2 equal square cells, NO visible grid, no labels. Render the SAME {item.identity} in four poses in ONE image, consistent identity, palette, volume, outline and light source across all cells. Top-left idle: {item.idle}. Top-right attack: {item.attack}. Bottom-left hit: {item.hit}. Bottom-right dead: {item.dead}. {item.palette}. Thick clean dark outlines, flat cel shading, saturated, simple bold silhouette readable at 64px, no intricate details. Slight 3/4 view toward viewer's RIGHT. Each pose entirely inside its own cell with ample transparent margin, same implied floor baseline at 85% down each cell, consistent body mass; idle occupies about 75% cell width. Fully transparent background, no shadows of any kind, no floor, no props, no scenery, no motion lines, no effects, no text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no borders, no watermark. Only these four depictions of the same {item.noun}.

monsters.name: 그릭
monsters.identity: small mischievous goblin with oversized pointed ears and one tiny fang
monsters.palette: Yellow-green skin, torn brown loincloth, small wooden club, ONE simple upper-left soft highlight
monsters.idle: standing in a slight crouch, club resting on one shoulder, crooked grin, ears up
monsters.attack: lunging right swinging the club overhead, body stretched toward the right target, eyes wide with glee
monsters.hit: recoiling left, ears flattened, club dropping from one hand, eyes squeezed shut
monsters.dead: sprawled flat on the ground on its back, limbs splayed, eyes as closed curved lines, tongue out comically

monsters.name: 나이트윙
monsters.identity: chubby round bat with oversized round ears and tiny fangs
monsters.palette: Deep indigo-purple fur, paler lilac wing membranes, ONE simple upper-left soft highlight
monsters.idle: hovering with wings spread in a relaxed shallow arc, body round and settled, cheerful
monsters.attack: swooping right with wings swept back and fangs forward, body stretched toward the right target
monsters.hit: tumbling left with wings crumpled inward, body squashed, eyes squeezed shut
monsters.dead: lying flat on its back on the ground, wings spread limp and flattened, eyes as closed curved lines

monsters.name: 스포어링
monsters.identity: walking mushroom with a wide cap and a plump stalk body with stubby legs
monsters.palette: Crimson red cap with cream spots, pale cream stalk, ONE simple upper-left soft highlight
monsters.idle: standing still and content, cap level, drowsy half-closed eyes, a few tiny spores drifting right beside the cap
monsters.attack: hopping right and headbutting with the cap tilted forward, stalk stretched toward the right target
monsters.hit: recoiling left with the cap knocked askew, stalk squashed down, eyes squeezed shut, spores scattering
monsters.dead: cap collapsed flat over the squashed stalk like a dropped umbrella, eyes as closed curved lines

monsters.name: 본가드
monsters.identity: stout little skeleton guard with a slightly oversized skull, a dented bronze helmet and a small round wooden shield
monsters.palette: Clean bone white, bronze helmet, brown shield, two soft blue glowing dots for eyes, ONE simple upper-left soft highlight
monsters.idle: standing at ease, shield lowered, helmet slightly too big and tipped back, goofy not frightening
monsters.attack: lunging right with a bony fist thrust forward and shield raised, body stretched toward the right target
monsters.hit: recoiling left, helmet sliding over the eye sockets, ribs squashed together, a few small bone chips popping off
monsters.dead: collapsed into a low flat pile of bones with the skull resting on top, helmet beside it, comically tidy not gruesome

monsters.name: 팽울프
monsters.identity: fluffy grey dire wolf pup with oversized paws and one fang showing
monsters.palette: Thick silver-grey fur with a darker charcoal mane, amber eyes, ONE simple upper-left soft highlight
monsters.idle: standing on all fours, ears forward and alert, tail up, mouth slightly open
monsters.attack: pouncing right with front paws extended and jaws open, body stretched toward the right target
monsters.hit: recoiling left with ears flat and tail tucked, body squashed low, eyes squeezed shut
monsters.dead: lying flat on its side on the ground, legs limp, tail still, eyes as closed curved lines

monsters.name: 레이스
monsters.identity: floating wraith with a wispy tail instead of legs and a tattered hood
monsters.palette: Pale cyan-white translucent body, slightly deeper teal at the hem, two soft glowing eyes, ONE simple upper-left soft highlight
monsters.idle: hovering upright and still, hood settled, tail curling gently below, gentle melancholy expression
monsters.attack: surging right with the hood swept back and arms reaching forward, body stretched toward the right target
monsters.hit: recoiling left, body rippling and compressed, hood collapsing over the eyes, eyes squeezed shut
monsters.dead: sunk to the ground as a low flat spreading puddle of pale mist, eyes as closed curved lines, hood flattened on top

monsters.name: 브락
monsters.identity: burly orc brute with broad shoulders, two tusks jutting up from the lower jaw, and a heavy axe
monsters.palette: Moss-green skin, brown leather straps and a grey fur shoulder pad, iron axe head, ONE simple upper-left soft highlight
monsters.idle: standing square and heavy with the axe resting on one shoulder, confident grin, chest out
monsters.attack: stepping right into a big overhead axe swing, body stretched toward the right target, tusks bared
monsters.hit: staggering left with the axe dropping low, shoulders squashed down, eyes squeezed shut
monsters.dead: flat on its back on the ground, arms out wide, axe fallen beside it, eyes as closed curved lines

monsters.name: 그래니트
monsters.identity: chunky blocky stone golem with oversized fists and a boxy head
monsters.palette: Warm grey granite with mossy green patches in the cracks, two glowing amber eyes set deep in the head, ONE simple upper-left soft highlight
monsters.idle: standing heavy and still, fists at its sides, shoulders high, slow and sturdy
monsters.attack: slamming one huge fist down to the right, body leaning toward the right target, small pebbles shaken loose
monsters.hit: rocking left with cracks widening across the chest, body compressed, eyes narrowed shut
monsters.dead: collapsed into a low flat heap of stone blocks with the head resting on top, amber eyes dark, moss still showing

monsters.name: 이그나리온
monsters.identity: small proud red dragon with short folded wings and stubby horns
monsters.palette: Scarlet scales with a cream belly, warm orange wing membranes, a tiny flame at the mouth corner, ONE simple upper-left soft highlight
monsters.idle: standing puffed up and proud, wings folded, chin raised, tiny flame flickering at the mouth
monsters.attack: rearing right breathing a short compact puff of flame toward the right target, wings flared, neck stretched
monsters.hit: recoiling left with wings clamped shut and neck pulled in, body squashed, eyes squeezed shut, flame snuffed out
monsters.dead: flopped flat on its belly on the ground, wings spread limp, neck and tail stretched out, eyes as closed curved lines, a small puff of smoke at the mouth
